lines.zh: 我踏着雪块拼成的腿走
lines.en: I walk on legs of packed snow
My mane is hard as ice chips

lines.zh: 我一步一步，雪在脚下碎
lines.en: I step and the snow crunches

lines.zh: 我走的路线都是背风的
lines.en: I keep to the lee side

lines.zh: 我抖了一下，冰屑飞起来
lines.en: I shudder and ice chips fly
I walk toward the watchtower
My hooves break the thin ice
I slow on the snow slope
I raise my head and check the wind
I skirt a heap of frozen grass

lines.zh: 我走过的地方雪都压实了
lines.en: The snow packs where I pass
I stop and listen
My tail is like a rod of ice
I never go far from here
I stand, coated in frost
My surface shines in the sun

lines.zh: 风把冰屑从我身上吹落
lines.en: Wind blows ice chips off me
My joints are frozen stiff
I wait for the tower's people
I have no body heat at all
My eyes are two ice hollows
My ears stand up
This snowfield is clean
I've stood here a long while
My shadow looks blue
I move a foreleg slightly
The ice ticks inside me
I go still again

lines.zh: 风吹过我的肋骨一样的冰棱
lines.en: Wind passes my icy ribs

lines.zh: 我又把蹄子并紧了一些
lines.en: I draw my hooves closer together
You stand out in the snow
I turn my chin toward you

lines.zh: 你身上的热气我能感觉到
lines.en: I can feel the heat off you
Don't press against me; you'll stick
Get on quickly if you're riding
My back is frosted; sit firm
Your boots are caked with snow
Are we going to the tower
I wait for you to mount

lines.zh: 你哈气的声音我听见了
lines.en: I hear you blowing on your hands
I turn my head into the wind

lines.zh: 鞍上没有鞍，我也备好了
lines.en: There's no saddle, but I'm ready

lines.zh: 我看了你一会儿，又看风
lines.en: I look at you a while, then at the wind

lines.zh: 你踩的每一步我都听着
lines.en: I hear every step you take
My surface cracks
I retreat, shedding ice
My legs lock briefly
I shake and re-settle
I make no sound

lines.zh: 我由雪块捏成，跑起来掉雪。
lines.en: Snow-block born; I shed snow as I run.
A little water seeps from the crack
I turn on icy hooves
A joint clicks
I'm still in my old snow hollow
That little warmth in your hand
It'll bead water on me
I step back into the snow
You can lay it on my back
It melts slower there
As long as it isn't too hot
Don't hold it at my eyes
I'll just look at it
Steady that hand or I'll melt
I smell sweet snow.
You hit me and ice chips fall
My hooves slip
You press against me and your coat sticks
I shoulder you off
We both hit a drift

lines.zh: 我的鬃毛磕到你的头盔
lines.en: My mane knocks your helmet

lines.zh: 我退了一步，地上有碎冰
lines.en: I step back onto broken ice

lines.zh: 你贴着我的冰壳挤过去
lines.en: You squeeze past my icy shell
That didn't knock off a single chip
I'm steady again
There's another on the snowfield
Its mane is longer than mine

lines.zh: 我们并肩站着，风从中间过
lines.en: We stand side by side and wind passes between

lines.zh: 我用鼻子碰它一下，凉的
lines.en: I touch it with my nose; it's cold

lines.zh: 雪原上我们的呼吸一般白。
lines.en: Our breath is equally white on the snowfield.

lines.zh: 它的蹄子陷得比我的深
lines.en: Its hooves sink deeper than mine

lines.zh: 我们一起踏碎了一小片冰
lines.en: We crack a patch of ice together
Snow lands on us and doesn't melt
Neither of us need make a sound
This snowfield fits two
I lower my icy neck to take it
It freezes in my mouth

lines.zh: 我吐出来，它结了一层霜
lines.en: I spit it out, frosted over

lines.zh: 我用前蹄把它拨了两下
lines.en: I nudge it twice with a forehoof
It rolls fast on the ice
I chase it two steps
It falls into a drift
I dig it out with my nose
I look twice; not interested
I push it back into the snow
You brought fire
I don't like that
I stand before the tower
My surface turns wet

lines.zh: 我一步一步往你那儿压
lines.en: I press toward you step by step
This is the camp's front
I lower my frozen head
I can see wherever you go
Your prints are in the snow
I follow them

lines.zh: 我的鼻息在冷空气里成了雾
lines.en: My breath fogs in the cold air

lines.zh: 我把前蹄在冰上蹭了两下
lines.en: I scrape a forehoof on the ice
I turn sideways across the path
You go around and I bear over
My steps sound in the snow
My mane stands up

lines.zh: 你退到冰面上，脚下不稳
lines.en: You retreat onto ice, unsteady
I don't slip at all
I wait for you to fall

lines.zh: 风从你背后吹，我听不清你
lines.en: Wind's at your back; I can't hear you well
But your tracks talk
I haven't paused a step
You retreat and I only press nearer
My steps are steady on the ice
You don't have hooves like these
I rear and stamp
The ice breaks into a pit
My shoulder hits your flank
You slide a distance
I butt your back
That cost me a piece of hoof
My mane cracks at you like a whip
You fall back into a drift

lines.zh: 雪做的马蹄，踩下去很实。
lines.en: Snow hooves land heavy.
I hear the ice under you

lines.zh: 雪堆里嵌着的一匹站了起来
lines.en: A horse embedded in a drift stands up
I shake myself out of the snow
Ice chips fall off my back
My mane stiffens first
The wind turns a circle here
My four hooves settle on the snow

lines.zh: 哨塔的影子落在我身上
lines.en: The tower's shadow falls on me
I look up to see which way the snow clouds go
The snow here is good for standing
Someone's been here; fresh prints

lines.zh: 哨塔下方的雪动了一下
lines.en: The snow below the tower shifts
I break out of the snow crust
My mane is a row of ice spikes
I stand in the wind and don't mind the cold
I set all four hooves
Someone raises their head to look
Fire makes water run off me
I fall and break into pieces
Water soaks me and I can't stand straight
The blast flips me onto the snow
An arrow chips my mane

lines.zh: 那股力量把我的冰震松了
lines.en: That force loosens the ice in me

lines.zh: 没有东西能留住我的形状
lines.en: Nothing holds my shape anymore

lines.zh: 雷击下来，我全身亮了一下
lines.en: Lightning strikes and I light up
No snow below; I come apart
